content.title: Chapter 86 - RETIREMENT — Sec. 86-80. - Sufficiency of pension.
content.summary:
The board shall ascertain from time-to-time, at least annually, if the funds of the
               pension fund are sufficient and actuarially sound to meet the obligations arising
               out of the retirement system.
(Code 1960, § 19-2(D); Code 1981, § 26-36)
